text: The one breaking change this week is #10520, where the blocked customer check event on table Customer now passes the extensible Gen. Journal Document Type enum instead of an option integer, so subscribers need updating. Most other merges are behaviour-changing fixes. In finance and costing, #12816 fixes reversed project planning lines on purchase invoices, #11714 changes assembly cost adjustment rounding, #10500 corrects additional-currency cost on project ledger entries, and #12551 addresses Sales Line VAT Prod. behaviour seen since 28.4. Subscription Billing got #12857, #12622 and #12377, covering shared contract numbers, contract currency and billing line rollback. Planning and manufacturing saw #12760 and #12464 (blocked items no longer stop Order Planning), #12098, #12542, #12669 and #12459 (subcontracting dates and run time pricing). Localization fixes include #12939, #12558, #12142, #12723, #12217 and #11757. Attachments and e-documents changed through #12609, #12554, #12432, #12333 and #11527. Fabric Mirroring gains #12565 (1000 tables) and #12339 (per-table reset). Non-behavioural work includes HTTP and URL refactors in #12755, #12614 and #12617, plus extensibility additions #11580 and #10523.
